verdicts.reason: A: the oversized SAVE 15% pill is the loudest thing on the canvas and pulls focus from the headline. The product bag is lost, leaving a blank blurred-brown rectangle in the middle-right with dead space after it. The tiny logo and bag thumbnail are jammed against the CTA, and the body copy wraps awkwardly. B: it has the same oversized badge, and its CTA has shrunk to a tiny, hard-to-read pill. The logo and bag are just specks beside it. Still, the headline and the one-line body read cleanly left to right, and the blurred image is only a thin sliver at the right edge, so B wastes less space than A's empty box.
